items.title: Something Is Watching Shinjuku
items.task: Find the enormous creature hiding above street level before anyone points it out. Photograph it.
items.reveal: Godzilla. The head sits above the Shinjuku Toho Building in Kabukicho.

moreInfo.title: Kaiju
moreInfo.text: Godzilla began as a film about fear and the sea. The head on this building is a shop-sign and a local joke.

items.notes: Find/photo mission. Do not show Godzilla clearly before the find.

items.title: How Do You Control This?
items.task: Find two design tricks that help huge numbers of people move through the station.
items.physicalObservation: Colours, numbers, floor marks, queues, sounds.

items.title: Tiny Tokyo
items.task: Find the smallest restaurant, alley or shop space you can.
items.reveal: Tokyo often solves tight land by going small and stacking up.
